basic_info.description: *This home was tenant-occupied when it was first listed, but it's now fully vacant. New interior painting, new light fixtures, minor kitchen and bathroom remodel, and landscaping improvements have been made.* Welcome to 32 Cross St, a charming 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offering 2,540 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space. With a flexible layout and plenty of room to spread out, this home is perfect for multi-generational living, guests, or simply enjoying extra space. Step inside to a bright and inviting living room that seamlessly connects to the kitchen, creating an open and welcoming feel. A separate family room with a cozy fireplace sits just beyond, offering the perfect spot to unwind. A dedicated laundry room is available, adding extra convenience. Downstairs, the home opens up to another spacious family room, complete with a wet bar, ideal for entertaining or creating a relaxed lounge space. You'll have direct access to the one-car garage and a tranquil backyard featuring a beautiful pond, the perfect place to unwind after a long day. With two bedrooms and one bath on each level, this home offers endless possibilities. Whether you're looking for extra privacy, guest accommodations, or a flexible layout, 32 Cross St has it all.
